@graph.name: Three steps, and no rollout to manage
@graph.description: There is no territory to map and no team to train. You hand over the lists, we set up each login, and your customers begin ordering.

step.name: Hand over your guides
step.text: A spreadsheet is plenty. Items and the price per account load into one admin screen, against the codes you already use.

step.name: Each account gets set up
step.text: We load each guide and create the login, then the kitchen downloads the app. Most of them send something in before the day is out.

step.name: Orders arrive finished
step.text: Approved by the buyer, carrying a number and a time, laid out as your office expects.

@graph.name: Do we need a Pepperi alternative to take reorders by voice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Pepperi keeps serving your sales organization: the rep, the van and the shelf. VoiceOrder Solutions works beside it and deals only with how the reorder reaches you, so the better question is which part of the week hurts.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Pepperi?

acceptedAnswer.text: At pulling an order out of a kitchen that will never log in, we think so. At everything else on their product list the question does not really apply: we have no route accounting, no store audits, no CRM and no promotion engine. That is the reason to keep both.

@graph.name: Doesn't Pepperi already let customers order for themselves?

acceptedAnswer.text: It does. They offer a branded self-service portal with each buyer's own catalog and pricing. Every route into it still means working a screen: searching the catalog, scanning a barcode or uploading a file. The accounts that were not going to do that are the ones our app suits.

@graph.name: Is Pepperi connected to VoiceOrder Solutions?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Nothing ties them together, and each company backs only its own product. Pepperi's orders keep flowing the way they do now, and ours reach your own system by a separate route, in any format listed above.

@graph.name: Won't some accounts end up with a portal and an app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only the ones you choose. Buyers happy in the Pepperi portal can stay there; offer our app to the kitchens that still phone. Those calls keep coming in as they do today, without an order number from us, because only what is sent through our app gets one.

Pepperi publishes no price on its own site, and neither do we. Third-party directories do carry figures for them, so check any number you are shown against their own site. Since Pepperi stays, the only question on our side is what one added step costs, and a quote answers that.

@graph.name: How fast could this be running?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most distributors this is running in 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens get a first order in the same day. There is no IT project, since nothing in Pepperi is connected or changed, so adding us asks far less than a Pepperi alternative that takes over from it.

@graph.name: Where do the Pepperi details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sourced from pepperi.com as it stood on 10 October 2026: their product modules, the buyer portal, the offline apps and their own words about the market they sell to. No price or rollout time is published by them, so neither is guessed at here. Anything out of date since is our error, not theirs.
